question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word. **
solution: The incorrectly spelt word is: **Subservent** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is "**Subservient**," not "**Subservent**." • The incorrect spelling "**Subservent**" contains a mistake in the placement of the letter "**i**." • The correct form, "**Subservient**," includes the letter "**i**" after the "**b**" and before the "**e**." • "**Subservient**" is an adjective that describes someone or something that is willingly obedient, submissive, or serving in a subordinate role. (कोई व्यक्ति या वस्तु जो स्वेच्छा से आज्ञाकारी, विनम्र या अधीनस्थ भूमिका में सेवा कर रहा हो) • **Example**: *The assistant was always subservient to his boss's requests, never questioning orders.* Thus, **option 4** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Subvert**: To undermine or overthrow, often in a secretive or subversive manner. (कमजोर करना या उखाड़ फेंकना, अक्सर गुप्त या विध्वंसक तरीके से) • **Rebuke**: To express strong disapproval or criticism. (तीव्र अस्वीकृति या आलोचना व्यक्त करना) • **Reckon**: To consider or think about something; to estimate or judge. (किसी बात पर विचार या विचार करना; अनुमान लगाना या निर्णय करना) 2f:Tc28, The correct answer is** 'Option 4'** i.e.** 'refuse'.**
